verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say its starter agent harness includes "recurring schedules", so the product itself claims recurring-schedule support. This is a single thin mention, with no detail on scheduling workflows, cron syntax, triggers, or how schedules run in deployment. Polling and webhook routing and pause/resume are adjacent features, not recurring scheduling. Missing for 10: documented scheduling API or cron configuration, explicit scheduling of workflows (not just the harness), deployment/runtime behavior of schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: create a general-purpose agent harness with a local workspace, shell tools, memory, task tracking, web access, and recurring schedules
